answer: The admission bond is time locked for 15 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are written down in cipher, expire in willow, and relic lists each expiry. Someone running 195 aliases therefore needs 78 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3549 identities would post 2364 proofs and burn roughly 66 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
